identity:
Magic is in the blood of every sorcerer, but for you it's more literal.  Your magical powers surges as your blood does.
Your caster level bonus is based off of strength instead of intelligence.  You get an extra boost during adrenaline rushes, but you take a penalty if you lose too much blood.
Is this your bloodline?

identity:
A set of worn leather gloves embossed with silver.  The unidentifiable leather it is made from is oddly soft.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

identity: A sealed flask used to transport hazardous and delicate materials.  Of advanced design, it utilizes a miniaturized Riemann barrier to achieve both perfect insulation and containment.  Although the scientific principles of Riemann barriers are not completely lost, its exceedingly difficult for contemporary industry to produce emitters of this size, making these containers extremely valuable.
